Game Overview

In Paper Boats Racing, the core idea is straightforward: navigate watery courses in Paper Boats Racing, a charming 2D top-down game where skillful steering and wind mastery propel you to victory. Dash for rare lightning bolt boosts, customize your craft, and master the art of racing across picturesque laps, all while carefully avoiding collisions. Victory awaits the nimble!
